import pytest
from httpie.output.formatters.headers import HeadersFormatter

class TestHeadersFormatter:

 def test_init_with_sort_enabled(self):
 format_options = {'headers': {'sort': True}}
 formatter = HeadersFormatter(format_options=format_options)
 assert formatter.enabled is True
 assert formatter.format_options['headers']['sort'] is True

 def test_init_with_sort_disabled(self):
 format_options = {'headers': {'sort': False}}
 formatter = HeadersFormatter(format_options=format_options)
 assert formatter.enabled is False
 assert formatter.format_options['headers']['sort'] is False

 def test_format_headers_sorts_by_name(self):
 formatter = HeadersFormatter(format_options={'headers': {'sort': True}})
 headers_input = (
 "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n"
 "Content-Type: text/html\r\n"
 "Host: example.com\r\n"
 "Connection: close"
 result = formatter.format_headers(headers_input)
 lines = result.split('\r\n')
 assert lines[0] == "HTTP/1.1 200 OK"
 assert lines[1] == "Connection: close"
 assert lines[2] == "Content-Type: text/html"
 assert lines[3] == "Host: example.com"

 def test_format_headers_single_line(self):
 formatter = HeadersFormatter(format_options={'headers': {'sort': True}})
 headers_input = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK"
 result = formatter.format_headers(headers_input)
 assert result == "HTTP/1.1 200 OK"

 def test_format_headers_preserves_relative_order_of_same_name(self):
 formatter = HeadersFormatter(format_options={'headers': {'sort': True}})
 headers_input = (
 "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n"
 "Set-Cookie: a=1\r\n"
 "Accept: text/html\r\n"
 "Set-Cookie: b=2\r\n"
 "Set-Cookie: c=3"
 result = formatter.format_headers(headers_input)
 lines = result.split('\r\n')
 assert lines[0] == "HTTP/1.1 200 OK"
 assert lines[1] == "Accept: text/html"
 assert lines[2] == "Set-Cookie: a=1"
 assert lines[3] == "Set-Cookie: b=2"
 assert lines[4] == "Set-Cookie: c=3"
